2317-7084-8095-8345.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

1322-1395-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2178-2380-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-5686.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

1479-2841-6926-7892.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6926-7892.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2527-3143-3464-6495.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-3143-3464-6495.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2527-3143-3464-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-4247-6487.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
An opponent controls seven or more creatures.
628-4247-6487.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, and repeat from step 1.
Cast Canker Abomination by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Canker Abomination dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3240-6351-6462-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

849-2738-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1477-2558-7916.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, its living weapon ability granted to it by Ekthi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token. It'll enter as a 1/1 due to Ekthi's static effect.
When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

4-1170-1636-7523.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Vibrant Idea using convoke without paying mana.
4-1170-1636-7523.description:
Cast Vibrant Idea using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Landscape Painter.
When Landscape Painter enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2034-4289-6970-7175-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1169-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
1169-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

413-3081-3817-7772.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger from step 3, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Valiant Changeling enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Valiant Changeling trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any artifact you control

2047-7748.easyPrerequisites: Ant-Man's power is at least 8 minus the number of Treasures you control, minus an additional 1 if Mechanized Production is attached to a Treasure.
2047-7748.description:
Deal combat damage using Ant-Man, triggering its ability, creating a number of Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a copy of the artifact it's attached to and causing you to win the game.

4866-4893-6822-7426.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4866-4893-6822-7426.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

851-1558-3875-4231-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-1558-3875-4231-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1169-2085-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

7-3140-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-3140-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat.

141-6797-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

1170-1322-1329-1414.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4905-5220-6794-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1734-2438-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1182-5220-6247.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Stonecoil Serpent from your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

247-1495-4613.description:
Activate Twinblade Paladin by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Twinblade Paladin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3750-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to red is at least five.
3750-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

56-1417-4556-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-4556-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Blight Mound and Bridge from Below trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-4556-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1429-4452-5315-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4452-5315-5402.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2438-5011-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
2438-5011-5326.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1734-4344-4605-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Fiend Hunter until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning any cards exiled with it to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a copy of Lumbering Battlement that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Lumbering Battlement until the token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
The nontoken Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, choose not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling the token Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Lumbering Battlement from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2232-2537-3604.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it, Cadric and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Cadric trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghalta with haste.
When the Ghalta token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ghalta token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ghalta token's trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Ghalta tokens.

2034-3496-4071-4452.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Slaver, adding {C}{C}.
When Dread Slaver dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-4809-5220.description:
Cast Shifting Wall either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Shifting Wall on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

34-2034-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {C}{C}.
Cormela dies, returning Footsteps of the Goryo from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying {2}{B}, putting Cormela from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
